purpose: Remove a profiler-measured Python runtime defect without changing checkpoint weights, graph weights, output vocabulary, decoding policy, or generated-token semantics.

triggering_profile.measured_bottleneck: The immutable global-token-ID to local-logit-index map was reconstructed once per prefill/decode graph call despite remaining unchanged for the entire non-adaptive sequence.

single_allowed_change.change: Construct the token-local index once per sequence and pass the same immutable mapping through persistent NativeState.
single_allowed_change.adaptive_exception: Adaptive shortlists may rebuild only when the graph returns a different active token-ID vector.

verification.profile: Repeat the same profiler workload and require token-local map construction calls to fall from one per graph call to one per non-adaptive sequence.
verification.semantic_equivalence: For a locked prompt set, require exact authoritative generated token IDs, output bytes, routes, cache lengths, and ABI state to match the pre-change runner.
verification.screen: Run the unchanged 40-observation sustained 1,024-byte benchmark first.
verification.promotion: Only a full sustained PASS permits the unchanged native ABI/general/headline/physical/identity/adversarial/three-seed campaign.

evidence_binding: All newly emitted native inference and benchmark evidence must include the SHA-256 of abi/layercake_host_runtime.py.
claim_boundary: This is a runtime implementation correction supported by one measured hotspot, not a model-quality improvement or a new semantic architecture.
